Description: Patchgate spoke (generated by providers/aws/stacksets/generate.py - do not edit)

Properties.Description: Assumed by the Patchgate hub to bootstrap and patch managed instances.

Properties.Name: patchgate-forward-ec2-running
Properties.Description: Forward EC2 running events to the Patchgate hub.

Properties.Name: patchgate-forward-drift
Properties.Description: Forward Patchgate drift findings to the hub.

Content.description: Patchgate bootstrap for Linux: applies an install plan with the core installer.

Plan.description: Install plan produced by the Patchgate catalog (gz1:<base64>).

Content.description: Patchgate bootstrap for Windows: applies an install plan with the core installer.

Plan.description: Install plan produced by the Patchgate catalog (gz1:<base64>).

Content.description: Patchgate drift check: re-validates agents and hardening, publishes findings.

runCommand:
set -uo pipefail
INSTALLER=/opt/patchgate/patchgate_install.py
EVENT_FILE=/var/lib/patchgate/drift-event.json
if [ ! -f "$INSTALLER" ]; then echo "not bootstrapped by Patchgate; skipping"; exit 0; fi
python3 "$INSTALLER" --drift
rc=$?
if [ -f "$EVENT_FILE" ]; then
  TOKEN=$(curl -sf -X PUT http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token -H 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 60')
  md() { curl -sf -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/$1"; }
  REGION=$(md placement/region)
  IID=$(md instance-id)
  ENTRIES=$(mktemp)
  python3 - "$EVENT_FILE" "$IID" > "$ENTRIES" <<'PY'
import json, sys
detail = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
detail["instanceId"] = sys.argv[2]
print(json.dumps([{"Source": "io.patchgate", "DetailType": "Patchgate Drift Detected", "Detail": json.dumps(detail)}]))
PY
  if [ "$(aws events put-events --region "$REGION" --entries "file://$ENTRIES" --query FailedEntryCount --output text)" = "0" ]; then
    rm -f "$EVENT_FILE"; echo "drift event published"
  else
    echo "failed to publish drift event" >&2
  fi
  rm -f "$ENTRIES"
fi
exit $rc
